text: Duplicate the block. Set the colour of the diamonds to purple.
Caption algae "phase A". Then rename the same one to Raven.
Shift the Aunt to the left. Because the old one was wrong. Which rules are active? Uncle is above Dave. Thanks!

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Place a silver circle. After that, nudge the grey ball left! Going forward, everything is pink. Push Pod2 and Ingress to the right of Billing. Which one is nearest from Lambda?
Let me see. Wire Story to Sprint1, Sprint2 and Doing. After that, send Backlog behind. I keep losing track of things. Connect this one to Task7. Then change the shape of lime diamonds to a hexagon.

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Tie Whisk to Butter and Butter to Dough, then add a purple triangle named Opal between Sugar and Batter. Then duplicate Opal 3 times. Because the old one was wrong. What can I reach from the latest square?
Add a label "no" to icing. What color is it?
Describe the diagram? By default diamonds are normal and magenta. Just tidying things up a bit. Rename the box into Tundra. Is the crimson ellipse bigger than Milk?
Space Diode and Led horizontally evenly. Also, join Sensor to Diode and Diode to Battery.
Dave is large! Is the oldest square a square? Is the star smaller than Dad? Stamp "Output" on this one. Put it between Sophia and Alice.
Sketch me an enormous rhombus on the top! Is Ending left side of Scene3? Is the silver ball larger than the first aqua diamond? What shape is the rect?
Revert that. Attach Rack3, Gateway and Nas each to the next one, and duplicate Gateway! Just tidying things up a bit. Is Nas to the left of Vpn?
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Organize in a grid, then scoot Crab, Algae and Plankton between Whale and Squid!
Morph every element that is not magenta into a triangle. After that, draw a diamond. Next, move the yellow star below Stopped. How many turquoise stars are above the most recent triangle?
Navbar is between Sidebar and Footer. Slap a couple of blue hexagons on the left side! Almost done.
Count the links? Shove yeast right of Bowl!
Turn the newest dot minuscule! Is it white? Bring it to the front.
My manager asked for this. Drop the defaults. Is Modem along the right edge? Send the same one to the back.
Show me the triangles? Nuke all the gold ones, and after that spawn 8 scarlet dots left of Otter.
How many neighbours does the green hexagon have? What is Button1? List the boxes?
Change the ovals to normal and slide the ball right. Then paint the violet ones blue.
This is for tomorrow's review. Plonk a large scarlet dot between Header and Menu! New triangles should be crimson! Is the crimson oval on top of Card? Show me the leftmost shape?
Hmm, let me think. Unhook Ground and Sensor. Also, rename the brown box Sierra.
Is the first star bigger than Heron? Tie Plankton and Crab to Algae. That way it is easier to read. Which one is the most connected?
Let me see. Hook Stopped up to Loading. Also, organize Closed and Halted in a row! Is Error downstream of Booting?
This is for tomorrow's review. Ap2 is to the left of Firewall. We need it for the meeting. Bring it to the front. Next, rename it to Zinnia. Perfect.
Throw an average square between Done and Finish with the name Sage, then copy the latest one 2 times. Nice.
Make the new triangle twice as large. After that, connect the same one to Plant.
Reshape squares into a dot. Rename the first golden diamond into Lotus.
Forget all rules, then colour all the lilac ones amber. Almost done. Make the first block a little smaller! What color is it?
Dock leads to Retailer. Describe the diagram? List everything under Store?
My manager asked for this. Are there loops? Recolor the square magenta!
Create a silver ball at the center, name it Raven, then paint Raven amber and link it to Idea!
What text is on the dot? How many turquoise stars are right of the earliest square? Show me the connections? Pop a little indigo rectangle along the top!
Send the last triangle backward. Which node is the topmost?
Re-apply. That's the main flow. Tidy up Cellar and Closet, label every magenta rect "login". Then insert a blue two-way connection from Closet to Bedroom.
Bring all the green triangles in front! Show me the connections?
Delete the default rules. Next, add a star with the name Wren.
Make Yeast, Dough and Butter twice as large. How many stars are on the canvas?
Who has the most connections? Create a dotted plain link from Cto to Finance and redo. Almost done.
Axe all the squares that are not lime. Also, link Bedroom to Attic, Attic to Closet, and then put Office and Porch on the right of Bathroom! List all blue circles?
Link the oldest star with Vcc. Then call Diode Hazel. What default rules do we have?
I'm explaining this to my team later. Change the newest star to a massive ball. After that, send it to the back.
Shift all of the rects to the middle, and then enlarge them. I keep losing track of things. Align them vertically.
Blocked between Backlog and Sprint1. Is it turquoise? Wipe the canvas. Also, join Blocked and Sprint2!
Set the shape of the ovals that are not magenta to square, then slap a blue square called Lark to the right of Hub. Grow Lark!
Change diamonds to a tiny block. Next, link Customs and Retailer to Hub. Count the indigo ellipses?
Tie Keeper to Guard and Qb, and bring all triangles in front. Just tidying things up a bit. Label all ellipses beta. Almost done. Send the newest star to the back!
Hmm, let me think. Set the colour of the cyan squares to brown. Sorry, long day. Plonk a minuscule fuchsia circle named Birch. Then connect the magenta ball to Cave. Nice.
How many lime stars are left of Porch? Trash Cellar, Bathroom and Lounge.

Place a pair of green circles labeled "Error 404" in the bottom right corner, and after that create an enormous rectangle next to Sales with the text "sync". After that, push the rectangle downwards! Thanks.
Chapter4 and Intro trade places. After that, put a minuscule navy oval between Scene2 and Chapter4 and then drag the newest one in the top left corner. After that, spawn a huge oval next to Ending.
Are there any lilac hexagons that are not yellow? Pop a teal hexagon labeled "upload" between Center and Keeper!
Hmm, let me think. Title the lime diamond "x > 0". Ugh, messy. Nudge it down. Next, make it a bit smaller, and grow the white squares a bit! Perfect.
We are planning the next sprint. Does Pluto connect to Cell? Which node is the lowest?
Enlarge all the ellipses. We need it for the meeting. Cancel the rules. That's the main flow. Add a caption "cold" to the most recent aqua ellipse.
Pantry is brown. Stamp "phase A" on it, and after that push the star to the left! What color is it?

Sketch a regular rhombus on the left of the green block! Ugh, messy. Is the last one navy? Which one is farthest from the newest square? Organize Grandpa and Liam vertically. That's the main flow. Make each hexagon a cyan ball.
My manager asked for this. Scale the most recent indigo square up. It should read better now. Distribute everything evenly vertical.
Banish all shapes and then undo the last step.
Show me the bottommost shape? Morph the amber diamonds into a triangle!
Shift Navbar and Banner downwards. Also, slap a brown hexagon above the oldest violet star, then rename the newest triangle as Xenon, and then make the newest circle average! Nice.
Make a copy of Temple. Show all squares at the top edge? Tidy up!
This is for tomorrow's review. Throw nine yellow triangles between Jupiter and Saturn, then insert 4 regular blue stars!
This is for tomorrow's review. Which shape has the fewest arrows? Slap an amber rectangle named Nook "Pending". I keep losing track of things. Send Nook to the back!
Tie Orbit and Atom to Comet. Then spread all the shapes evenly! Is the oval below Cell?
Put Attic between Bedroom and Lounge. It should read better now. How many squares left side of Attic? Bring the last hexagon in front, and drag the same one between Pantry and Lounge.
Tuck the items between Decide and Draft. Grow them. Ugh, messy. Arrange them as a column.
Turn the white ones into a little blue square! How many arrows are there? Make a triangle labeled Q1.
Set the shape of the white star to rhombus, and then push that one downwards. Send it to the back.
Insert a medium block to the lower-right. Also, make Locked and Idle average, and exchange Loading with Waiting.
Kill all shapes, and then turn dots into a silver triangle. Just tidying things up a bit. Make a copy of Billing and bring the square to front!
Change all the golden ones to large! Does Todo connect to Testing?
Do the arrows form a loop? Add a big dot in the bottom-left corner, connect the circle to Api. Also, nudge the new triangle by 250 pixels upwards!
Trash triangles. Then trash blocks!
This is for tomorrow's review. Attach Armed to Error, organize vertically! Thanks!
Line up Cream, Mix and Eggs vertically! Are there any white stars? Set everything to small. Almost done.
New triangles should be lime. How many ellipses do we have?
Are there any ovals? How many connections does the yellow ellipse have? Which one is leftmost?
Let me see. Sketch a tiny purple dot between Capacitor and Ground named Kepler. That's the main flow. Stamp "hot" on Kepler.
This is for tomorrow's review. Shove the newest star on the bottom! What color is the same one? Shift it 100 px down.
Is Metrics between Idea and Team? Color this one navy. Next, move that one to the right!
From now on triangles should be indigo. Create a black dot with the name Quartz. Bring all the triangles in front.
Is Closet joined to Kitchen? Get rid of the arrow from Porch to Lounge. Is Garage not gold? Bring this one to the front!
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Throw another little hexagon on the left of Search. After that, rename the hexagon to Opal. It was getting crowded. Undo. Perfect.
Change the color of Village to grey. Right, that's better. Is that one orange? Is the grey ball beside Forest?
I'm explaining this to my team later. What text is on Sink? Bring the first gray block forward. Is the same one green? Turn the indigo oval lime. Almost done. List everything by Train?
Banish the star. Also, give Users a green color and stamp "yes" on it!
Rename Source Tundra. Then nudge the Monitor left.
Is the diamond big? Put it on the bottom, and then attach Dns and Nas to Gateway. Then paint the lime ellipses scarlet.
How many grey diamonds do we have? Scale the square up!
Make a dashed connection from Cave to Castle. Get rid of the wire from Shrine to Volcano. After that, remove the line between Mine and Harbor. Make a copy of the star.
Line up all hexagons vertical. Next, draw a triangle named Willow on the left.
Let me see. Store and Port trade places! In future, balls are tiny. Make a little triangle.
Drag the circles down. How many edges does Deploy have?
My manager asked for this. Make the violet ones a star. Almost done. Rename Supplier as Karma!
We are planning the next sprint. How many squares along the left edge? What is on the canvas? Link Corner2 and Qb to Tackle. Also, change the shape of the green ones to an ellipse. Almost done.
Label all of the white triangles with "step 1" and add a normal golden diamond on top of Pantry.
Set the size of blue boxes to little. How many arrows does Keeper have? Is the circle in the bottom-left corner? Is this one indigo?
What is the number of stars? Park all objects above Validate. After that, tuck Etl and Parse left of Monitor.
